principles.rule: Track opponent elixir continuously: assume 1 elixir per 2.8s (1.4s in double, ~0.93s in triple), cap 10, subtract each card played. Start by logging every card costing 4+.
principles.weight_hint: Core state variable. Every evaluation should condition on estimated opponent elixir; treat the estimate as a range (+-1) that narrows after each opponent play.

principles.rule: Sitting at 10 elixir wastes income. Treat each second at 10/10 as losing ~0.36 elixir (0.71 in double). Prefer a cheap cycle card in the back over leaking.
principles.weight_hint: Strong negative term in move evaluation when own elixir is 10 and no threat is on board.

principles.rule: A defense is good if it costs less than the attack it stops while conceding little tower damage. Count surviving defenders as recovered value; count tower damage taken as a cost.
principles.weight_hint: Primary scoring rule for defensive moves: value = opp_spent - my_spent + surviving_value - tower_damage_cost.

principles.rule: After a +2 or better trade, convert immediately: counterpush with the survivors or punish the opposite lane while the opponent is behind. Advantage decays as elixir refills.
principles.weight_hint: Increase aggression weight proportionally to estimated elixir lead; a lead unused for ~6s is mostly gone.

principles.rule: Default to waiting when the opponent is idle and you are below 10 elixir; act when you are at 9-10, when the opponent just overcommitted, or when their key counter is out of cycle.
principles.weight_hint: Model 'pass' as a legal move with value ~0 at <9 elixir; its value turns negative near 10 elixir or when a punish window exists.

principles.rule: Do not open before ~9.5 elixir. Open with a cheap or defensive card at the back (behind the King Tower) to scout; never open with the win condition unsupported or with a spell on an empty lane.
principles.weight_hint: At t<10s, heavily penalize win-condition and spell plays; small bonus for cheap back-plays that reveal information.

principles.rule: Do not place a building touching your Princess Tower at the start; a Rocket or Lightning then hits both. Place spawners/pumps one tile away from towers.
principles.weight_hint: Placement penalty for buildings in splash range of a tower when the opponent may run Rocket/Lightning/Fireball.

principles.rule: A played card returns after the opponent plays four more cards. Track their last four cards; a threat is 'safe' to send when its hard counter was among them.
principles.weight_hint: Maintain opponent hand estimate (4 in hand, 4 in queue); boost attack value when the counter is in their queue, lower it when the counter is likely in hand.

principles.rule: In cycle decks, spend cheap cards (1-2 elixir) to reach the win condition faster than the opponent reaches its counter; outcycle their building or key defender.
principles.weight_hint: For cycle archetypes, value cheap cards partly by how much they accelerate the win condition's return.

principles.rule: Pull building-targeting troops (Hog, Giant, Ram, Royal Hogs) with buildings placed 4-5 tiles from the river in the middle, or defend in the 'pocket' between towers so both towers and the King can hit.
principles.weight_hint: Placement evaluator should prefer defensive placements that draw the attacker toward the center and give multi-tower coverage.

principles.rule: Place melee defenders in front of the tower to tank; place ranged/splash defenders behind or beside the tower so the attacker reaches them last. Kite with cheap troops across lanes.
principles.weight_hint: Placement priority: distraction/tank nearest the threat, damage dealers protected by tower range.

principles.rule: Activating your own King Tower early (Tornado, or pulling a Miner/Drill/Royal Ghost onto it) is a lasting defensive upgrade. Never activate the opponent's King with careless spells or deep placements.
principles.weight_hint: Big one-time bonus for safe self-activation; equal penalty for moves that hit the enemy King unnecessarily.

principles.rule: Split pushes (Three Musketeers, Royal Hogs, Recruits) force the opponent to divide elixir. Defend the lane with the larger threat fully and chip the other; do not overspend in one lane.
principles.weight_hint: When both lanes are threatened, allocate defense by threat DPS to tower, then compare remaining elixir.

principles.rule: When the opponent drops a tank (Golem/Giant/Hound/Pump) in the back, immediately pressure the other lane with the win condition to force a tower trade or elixir split.
principles.weight_hint: Punish bonus scales with opponent spend in back (>=5) and own elixir >=6.

principles.rule: After a successful defense, support surviving troops instead of letting them walk alone; a counterpush costs less than a fresh push and arrives while the opponent is low.
principles.weight_hint: Add survivor value to attack evaluation; prefer attacks that chain off existing troops.

principles.rule: Spell the tower only when (a) it finishes the tower, (b) spell cycling wins the race in double elixir, or (c) the spell also hits a troop. Otherwise hold spells for defense/value.
principles.weight_hint: Value tower-spell = tower damage only if it crosses a finish or tiebreaker threshold; otherwise subtract defensive opportunity cost.

principles.rule: If a tower is within ~2-3 Rockets/Fireballs and you can defend with the rest of the deck, cycle the spell every rotation in double/triple elixir. Decide the race by comparing their counters and your defensive leftover.
principles.weight_hint: Trigger a 'spell-cycle mode' when tower_hp <= k*spell_damage and own defense cost per rotation < elixir income per rotation.

principles.rule: Bait decks present several targets for one spell (Barrel, Gang, Princess, Skeleton Barrel). Save the small spell for the highest-value target (usually Goblin Barrel) and answer the rest with troops.
principles.weight_hint: Against bait, raise the opportunity cost of using Log/Zap/Arrows on anything but the primary target; track whether their Barrel is in hand.

principles.rule: Predict spells only when the opponent has repeated the same response in the same spot and the gain outweighs a miss. After they spell, push for ~10s while that spell is out of cycle.
principles.weight_hint: Prediction-spell value = P(repeat)*value - (1-P)*cost; P rises with observed repetitions.

principles.rule: Do not repeat the same defensive placement three times against the same push; good opponents will pre-spell or re-route it.
principles.weight_hint: Small penalty for identical placements vs identical attacks after two repetitions.

principles.rule: Send Ice Spirit/Skeletons ~0.5s before or alongside Hog at the bridge so they tank the building/defender's first hits; pre-place Hog at the bridge, support at the river edge.
principles.weight_hint: Combo evaluator rewards Hog + 1-elixir support when the opponent likely has a building; penalize naked Hog into a known building.

principles.rule: Drop a tank (Giant/Golem/Hound) behind the King at ~8-10 elixir; add support behind it when it crosses the bridge, not before, so support survives the opponent's spell.
principles.weight_hint: Penalize support placed before the tank reaches the river; bonus for support placed after opponent's spell is spent.

principles.rule: Bridge spam succeeds when the opponent has just spent 4+ elixir elsewhere or their hard counter (Mini PEKKA, Mega Knight, building) is out of cycle. Spam into a full-elixir opponent loses.
principles.weight_hint: Attack-timing weight tied to opponent elixir estimate <=5 and counter-out-of-cycle flag.

principles.rule: When behind on elixir, stop attacking: make cheapest-possible defenses, accept chip damage over overspending, and cycle cheap cards to re-sync. Recover before pushing.
principles.weight_hint: When estimated deficit >= 3, scale down attack values and reward minimum-cost defense.

principles.rule: Single elixir (0:00-2:00) is for information, chip and positive trades. Avoid committing >7 elixir unless punishing; aim to enter double elixir with a tower-HP or elixir edge.
principles.weight_hint: Lower variance preference: cap push commitment in single elixir unless opponent made a large mistake.

principles.rule: In double elixir (final 60s of regulation and all of overtime) commit to full pushes; beatdown and spell-cycle decks peak here, cycle decks must defend with towers and chip.
principles.weight_hint: Archetype-specific: beatdown aggression up, cycle defense up; opponent elixir cap matters less, counter-availability matters more.

principles.rule: Triple elixir (final minute of overtime) makes defense nearly free: spam counters, never stay below 5 elixir, and prefer splash plus buildings because swarms are constant.
principles.weight_hint: Collapse elixir-cost penalties; evaluate mostly on tower-HP delta and tiebreaker position.

principles.rule: If regulation ends tied on crowns, overtime: first tower kill wins. If overtime ends with no kill, the player whose lowest-HP tower is lower loses (identical HP = draw outside duels). Protect your weakest tower; chip theirs.
principles.weight_hint: In overtime, objective becomes max(min(my_tower_hp)) - max(min(opp_tower_hp)); single tower kill is decisive.

principles.rule: In the last 30s of regulation, do not start a slow push that cannot connect; instead hold defense if ahead, or send fast win conditions/spells if behind on tower HP to force overtime or a lead.
principles.weight_hint: Time-aware: discount pushes whose expected arrival is after the clock unless overtime is likely.

principles.rule: After taking one tower, play for the clock and defend the other side: the enemy King Tower is active and the opponent must come to you. Only go for three crowns when far ahead on elixir.
principles.weight_hint: Once ahead 1-0 in crowns, set aggression low and risk-aversion high.

principles.rule: Identify the opponent's archetype from their first 3-4 cards and switch matchup plan: tank in back = beatdown, cheap card at bridge = cycle/bridge spam, building at river = siege.
principles.weight_hint: Maintain archetype posterior; feed into matchup plan selection.

principles.rule: Since Aug 2026 every Hero and Champion ability (except Boss Bandit) is single-use per deployment. Expect it on first deploy; after it is used, that unit is a normal troop.
principles.weight_hint: Track ability_used flag per deployed hero; value their deployment higher when ability is available.

principles.rule: Count the opponent's evolution cycles: an evolution fires every N plays of that card (1-3). Hold the best counter for the evolved deploy, use cheaper answers for normal ones.
principles.weight_hint: Track evo counters per card; raise threat value of the deploy that will be evolved.

principles.rule: Since the Aug 2026 Spirit HP nerf, Archers, Musketeer, Tesla, Bomber and Archer Queen one-shot Spirits and Spirits no longer connect to towers alone; do not spell them.
principles.weight_hint: Lower threat value of lone spirits; raise defensive value of one-shot troops against them.

principles.rule: Ronin blocks one ground melee hit every 3.5s and reflects it. Counter him with ranged, air, swarms or spells; do not trade single melee units into him.
principles.weight_hint: Melee-vs-Ronin matchup penalty; ranged/air bonus.

principles.rule: Minion Giant is a 4-elixir flying building-targeter immune to spell knockback; it needs air-targeting DPS (Musketeer, Mega Minion, Inferno, Hunter) not buildings alone.
principles.weight_hint: Treat ground-only defenses (Cannon, Cannoneer tower) as non-answers.

principles.rule: Adjust chip math to the tower troop: Dagger Duchess shreds swarms but runs dry under sustained pressure; Cannoneer cannot hit air; Royal Chef buffs allied troops; Tower Princess has the most HP.
principles.weight_hint: Tower troop should be an input to every threat/defense estimate.

archetypes.gameplan: Build one large push behind a tank in double elixir; defend minimally in single elixir and accept chip. Peak in double/triple elixir where support can be layered.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Punish the opposite lane the moment the tank drops; kill support with spells before it crosses; use Inferno/building to melt the tank; never let a push accumulate uncontested.

archetypes.gameplan: Fast rotation (2.6-3.0 avg) to out-cycle counters; repeated cheap win-condition hits plus spell chip. Defend with buildings and cheap units, win on chip and spell cycle.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Keep a building in cycle, defend cheaply, and build a slow elixir lead; punish with heavy pushes in double elixir. Control decks that stop every Hog for 2-3 elixir grind cycle down.

archetypes.gameplan: Defend efficiently for positive trades, then counterpush with survivors; wins on accumulated small advantages and spell value in double elixir.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Avoid feeding the counterpush: use small chip pushes and spells rather than big commits. Siege and heavy beatdown force control to spend elixir it would rather bank.

archetypes.gameplan: Lock the building on the enemy tower from your side, defend it with cheap troops and buildings, and win on chip plus Rocket/Fireball cycle.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Tank the siege building with a mini-tank or pressure the other lane the moment it is placed; Earthquake, Royal Giant and pressure from bridge spam beat it. Keep a building in hand.

archetypes.gameplan: Overload the opponent's small spell: when Log/Zap is spent on one swarm, land the Barrel or Princess for free. Defend with cheap swarms, win on chip and Rocket.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Save the small spell for Goblin Barrel; kill Princess with troops/Log only when safe; run two spells or a splash tower troop. Rocket their Princess+tower only when it also pressures.

archetypes.gameplan: Send fast units at the bridge whenever the opponent spends elixir elsewhere; force awkward defenses and keep tempo. Best deck family in ranked, Nov 2026.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Keep 4-5 elixir of cheap answers (Mini PEKKA, Cannon, Tesla, Mega Knight) when they are near 4+ elixir; never drop a tank in back against an idle opponent; punish overcommits.

archetypes.gameplan: PEKKA as the defensive anchor; convert every PEKKA defense into a Ram/Bandit/Ghost counterpush; Poison supports.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Avoid feeding PEKKA; use swarms and chip, outcycle the Ram counters, and pressure where PEKKA is not. Graveyard and bait dodge PEKKA's value.

archetypes.gameplan: Mix of two plans (e.g. split-lane beatdown + cycle). Splits pressure across both lanes to overload a single-lane defender.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Commit defense to the lane with more tower DPS, chip the other; punish splits with a heavy single-lane push when they split elixir.

archetypes.gameplan: Control with Graveyard as the finisher: tank with a cheap troop, cast Graveyard on the far side of the tower with Poison on the counter. Strong in ranked (53.6%, Nov 2026).
archetypes.how_to_beat: Keep a cheap swarm or splash (Goblin Gang, Valkyrie, Bowler, Archers) for the Graveyard; kill the tank first; do not let Poison find two targets.

archetypes.gameplan: Hound in back at 9-10 elixir, Balloon behind it when the Hound crosses; Fireball/Zap for the air counters. Lava Hound is the best win condition by WR in Nov 2026.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Pressure the other lane as the Hound drops; save Inferno Dragon/Tower or Musketeer for the Balloon not the Hound; split pups with splash; never use Cannoneer.

archetypes.gameplan: Split 3M behind the King (2/1) so one spell cannot hit all; pair with split Royal Hogs/Ice Golem for simultaneous two-lane pressure.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Fireball/Poison the two-Musketeer side, defend the single side with a cheap unit; punish the 9-elixir commitment on the opposite lane instantly.

archetypes.gameplan: Mid-range tank that outranges buildings; cycle RG with Fisherman/Hunter defense and Fireball support.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Pull RG into the center with a building or Fisherman, kill it with PEKKA/Inferno/Mini PEKKA, then counterpush; its support is fragile to Fireball.

archetypes.gameplan: Mid-ladder control: defend with Mega Knight's jump splash and counterpush behind it. Weak at top ranked (47.2% WR, D tier, Nov 2026).
archetypes.how_to_beat: Do not drop swarms near it; use PEKKA/Inferno/Mini PEKKA plus kiting; play air win conditions; expect the jump and place bait a tile away.

archetypes.gameplan: Drill the tower from unexpected tiles (behind/side) to pull defenders out, often with Mirror for double drills; cheap cycle defense.
archetypes.how_to_beat: Hold a 2-3 elixir splash (Log, Bomber, Goblin Gang) for the drill's spawn point; place the counter on the drill side the moment it surfaces; do not panic-spell.

archetypes.gameplan: Decks built around strong evolution pairs (Knight+Skeletons rated the top pair, Season 89; Evo Battle Ram/Royal Ghost in bridge spam; Evo Mortar/Skeleton Barrel bait; Evo Elite Barbarians in Golem).
archetypes.how_to_beat: Count evolution cycles and save the hard counter for the evolved deploy; evolutions are 1 of every 1-3 plays, so the non-evolved copies can be answered cheaply.

matchups.plan: Punish every back tank with Hog/Miner on the other lane; kite the tank with the building, Musketeer the support, never overspend on the tank itself. Aim to win regulation before their double-elixir push.
key_moments: Tank dropped in back -> immediate opposite-lane push
Keep Cannon in hand for the bridge
Fireball their support before it reaches the bridge

matchups.plan: Accept early chip, defend Hog cheaply (building + 1 troop), bank elixir, and build the layered push in double elixir; one connected push wins the tower race.
key_moments: Do not drop tank before 1:30 unless opponent leaks
Spell the Musketeer when it is in Hog support
In double elixir stack support only after the tank crosses

matchups.plan: Hog the opposite lane whenever X-Bow/Mortar is placed; otherwise tank the building with Ice Golem/Knight and let the tower work. Out-cycle their Tesla.
key_moments: X-Bow placed -> count their elixir; if <4 push the other lane
Never Fireball a defended X-Bow unless it finishes it

matchups.plan: Place the building defensively first (pull Hog), then offensively only when they have just used their mini-tank; win on Rocket/Fireball chip in double elixir.
key_moments: Hog at bridge -> X-Bow/Mortar in the center as the building
Rocket cycle once tower <= 2 Rockets

matchups.plan: Chip early with Barrel/Princess while they are passive; in double elixir Inferno the tank and swarm the support; Rocket the push when it stacks.
key_moments: Tank in back -> Barrel immediately
Hold Inferno Tower for the tank, Goblin Gang for support

matchups.plan: Use splash (Baby Dragon/Bomber/Arrows) to defend cheaply, keep Log/Arrows for Barrel, and run one unanswerable push; do not let Princess chip for free.
key_moments: Count their Rocket: push when it is out of cycle
Arrows the Princess+Gang together

matchups.plan: Spam the opposite lane the instant the tank drops; make them defend with support elixir so the push never forms. Keep Electro Wizard/PEKKA for the tank.
key_moments: Golem/Hound placed -> Ram + Bandit other lane
Never trade elixir on the tank until it crosses the bridge

matchups.plan: Hold defense: do not drop the tank while they have >=5 elixir; defend bridge units with a building and mini-tank, then counterpush with the surviving defenders behind the tank.
key_moments: Ram at bridge -> Cannon/Mini PEKKA, not splash
Only commit the tank after a successful defense

matchups.plan: Defend every Hog for 2-3 elixir with a building and a cheap troop; build an elixir lead and win on spell cycle plus counterpushes in double elixir.
key_moments: Never overspend on a Hog
Rocket/Poison their support when it stacks on the bridge

matchups.plan: Avoid feeding; chip with naked Hog only when their building is out of cycle; otherwise defend and spell-cycle in the last minute.
key_moments: Count their building cycle
Fireball tower only when it ends the race

matchups.plan: Opposite-lane pressure on their tank drop, Inferno/PEKKA on the tank, spells on support; aim to be a tower up before double elixir.
key_moments: Tank in back -> punish
Save reset cards for the Inferno zap

matchups.plan: Siege the building offensively when they commit a tank behind the King; otherwise defend and chip; X-Bow becomes a defensive building against the big push.
key_moments: Tank dropped -> X-Bow at bridge immediately
Rocket the support cluster

matchups.plan: Chip relentlessly; they lack splash. Inferno Tower pulls Hog; Rocket cycle in double elixir usually wins the race against a 2.6 deck.
key_moments: Hog at bridge -> Inferno Tower or Knight+Gang
Start Rocket cycle when tower <= 3 Rockets

matchups.plan: Keep Log for Barrel always; Musketeer kills Princess; defend Gang with Ice Spirit/Skeletons; chip with Hog whenever their Knight is out of hand.
key_moments: Never Log the Gang if Barrel is in their hand
Fireball Princess + Goblin Gang stacks

matchups.plan: Do not feed PEKKA; defend Ram/Bandit with cheap troops, Poison their support, cast Graveyard when PEKKA is on the other lane or out of cycle.
key_moments: PEKKA deployed -> Graveyard opposite lane
Tornado Bandit into Knight/King tower

matchups.plan: Pressure constantly so they cannot afford Graveyard; keep Poison/Zap for the Graveyard and a cheap troop to kill the tank.
key_moments: Graveyard cast -> Poison on tower + Zap/Ghost on skeletons
Punish Ice Wizard back placements with a Ram

matchups.plan: Siege buildings cannot hit air; Hound tanks the siege building, Balloon follows; Fireball Tesla/Archers.
key_moments: X-Bow placed -> Hound on that lane
Balloon only when their Tesla is down

matchups.plan: Lock X-Bow/Mortar in single elixir while the Hound is slow; defend air with Musketeer/Archers/Tesla; Rocket the Balloon+Hound stack if needed.
key_moments: Hound dropped -> siege building offensively
Rocket when Balloon and Hound overlap

matchups.plan: Pressure the opposite lane every time the Hound drops; save Musketeer/Inferno for the Balloon, use the tower on the Hound; Fireball pups.
key_moments: Hound in back -> Hog other lane
Balloon placed -> Musketeer at range, Ice Spirit freeze

matchups.plan: Defend Hog cheaply with Tombstone/Barbarians, build the Hound push when they have no Inferno card, Fireball their Musketeer, Balloon behind the Hound at the bridge.
key_moments: Musketeer out of cycle -> go
Zap the Inferno Tower when it locks Balloon

matchups.plan: Punish tank drops with a 3M split; defend their push with Hunter/Ice Golem; the split forces the beatdown player to defend two lanes with slow units.
key_moments: Tank dropped -> pump or 3M behind King
Split 2/1 so Lightning cannot hit all three

matchups.plan: Fireball/Lightning the two-Musketeer side, counterpush with the tank on the single side; let them overcommit 9 elixir.
key_moments: 3M placed -> spell the pair, tank the single
Never pump-race; punish pumps with the win condition

matchups.plan: Keep RG out of the jump: place Fisherman/Hunter behind, pull Mega Knight into the center and melt it; Fireball the Witch/support.
key_moments: Mega Knight on RG -> Fisherman hook into King
RG only when MK is out of cycle

matchups.plan: Defend Hog with Mini PEKKA/Valkyrie not Mega Knight; use MK only on stacked support; counterpush behind MK once they are low.
key_moments: Never drop MK on a lone Hog
Baby Dragon on Skeletons/Spirits

matchups.plan: Drill behind the tower when their Knight/Ice Wizard is on the other lane; cheap defense; mirror the drill in double elixir for overload.
key_moments: Count their splash cycle
Double drill when both splash cards were just used

matchups.plan: Hold split elixir until their bridge units are answered; Royal Hogs opposite lane when they overcommit; Fireball Bandit+Ghost stacks.
key_moments: Ram at bridge -> Cannon/Cage
Spam defended -> Royal Hogs other lane

matchups.plan: Chip with Barrel while the siege building is defensive; Inferno Tower melts an offensive X-Bow; Rocket the X-Bow plus tower when overlapped.
key_moments: X-Bow offensive -> Inferno Tower + Knight
Rocket X-Bow + tower only if it also hits support

matchups.plan: Track evolution counters; save hard counters for the evolved cycle; exploit the non-evolved copies with cheap answers.
key_moments: Evo deploy imminent -> hold the counter
After evo used -> pressure that lane

phase_policy.single: 0:00-2:00 at 1 elixir/2.8s. Information and small edges: open late (~9.5 elixir) with a cheap back card, scout the archetype from their first 3-4 cards, make only positive trades, punish back tanks on the opposite lane, keep <=7 elixir committed unless the opponent blundered. Goal: enter double elixir with a tower-HP or elixir lead and the opponent's key counters known.
phase_policy.double: Final 60s of regulation and all of overtime at 1 elixir/1.4s. Beatdown/bridge spam commit layered pushes; cycle/control defend with towers plus buildings and switch to spell cycling if the race is winnable; bait and siege chip hard. Counter-availability matters more than raw elixir. If ahead in crowns, defend and run the clock; if behind on tower HP, create a forcing push before 0:30.
phase_policy.triple: Final minute of overtime (and triple-elixir modes): defense is almost free, so spam counters, keep splash and buildings in rotation, never sit below 5 elixir, and spell towers whenever the spell cannot be out-valued defensively. Towers die fast: protect the weakest tower before chasing a kill.
phase_policy.overtime: Entered if crowns are tied after 3:00; up to 2:00 long; first tower kill ends it. If no kill, the lowest-HP tower loses the tiebreak (identical HP = draw except in duels). Objective shifts to tower-HP differential: chip the weakest enemy tower, shield your own weakest with buildings/kiting, and value any tower kill as game-ending.
phase_policy.last_30s_regulation: If ahead in crowns or tower HP: play purely defensive, do not start pushes, bank elixir for the final enemy push. If behind: send fast win conditions and spells that can connect before 0:00 to equalize crowns or HP; slow tanks dropped now arrive in overtime, which is acceptable only if you expect overtime.

tower_troops.notes: Default troop. Highest HP of the four (~4,424 at L15), 0.8s hit speed, moderate DPS (~197), hits air and ground. Best all-round consistency; strong versus siege and chip because of the HP pool. Nothing special to play around; standard chip math applies.

Epic (Arena 8). Lowest HP (~3,792 L15), highest single-hit damage (~223 DPS) with a slow cannon shot; GROUND ONLY. Excellent versus Giant/Royal Giant/Mega Knight/Goblin Giant pushes and swarms die slowly to it, but it cannot touch Lava Hound, Balloon, Minion Giant, Minions or Bats. Against a Cannoneer user: play air win conditions and air chip; as a Cannoneer user, your deck must carry all anti-air itself. Pick rate ~1% at top ladder; F/bottom tier in 2026 lists.

Legendary (Arena 11). ~4,013 HP, stockpiles up to 8 daggers (one every ~0.9s) while idle and throws them in a burst, giving the highest DPS when charged (~312) but low per-hit damage once empty. Shreds swarms, Skeletons, Goblin Gang, Graveyard and bait pushes; weak once drained by sustained pressure (tank + continuous troops) and against high-HP single targets. The usual pick for cycle and bait decks; ~12% pick rate at top 200 (Jan 2026), top tier in 2026 lists. Against a Duchess: pressure continuously so she never recharges, lead with a tank to absorb the burst, then send the real threat.

Legendary (Arena 13). ~4,234 HP, lowest DPS (~158). Instead of raw damage she cooks pancakes that level up a nearby allied troop by one level (she does not heal towers). Value is conditional: pays off with high-HP win conditions and support that stays near the tower (beatdown, Royal Giant, Graveyard tanks); wasted in cycle, siege and bait. Against a Chef: her low DPS makes chip and swarm pressure cheaper; kill the buffed unit first, and she is the easiest tower to out-DPS in a Rocket race.

meta_context.season: Season 89 'King vs King' (Nov 2 - Dec 7 2026): Evo Giant, Evo Mirror (shop week 2), Deck Wizard, Daily Puzzles, King of Cards event Nov 9 - Dec 7 (Giant + Mirror boosted all season, rotating boosted win conditions weekly), CRL World Finals Shanghai Nov 6-8.
meta_context.balance: No balance pass at Season 89 start; current stats come from the Oct 19 2026 (Season 88 mid-season/final) changes: nerfs to Hero Ice Wizard ability (-48%), Barbarian Barrel, Skeletons spawn radius, Evo Cannon, Royal Ghost HP, Minion Giant hit speed, Elixir Collector rework; buffs to Lava Hound damage (53->71), Goblin Barrel, X-Bow, Wall Breakers, Ram Rider, Goblin Drill, Three Musketeers, Monk; Golden Knight rework (dash 5.5->5.0). Only November change seen: Goblin Hut spawn 1.9->2.1s (Nov 3). Earlier 2026: Aug 4 Spirit HP nerf + all Hero/Champion abilities single-use (except Boss Bandit); Sept 8/16 nerfs to Evo Battle Ram, Hero Balloon, Hero Ice Wizard freeze (7->5s), Minion Giant damage, Goblinstein; Ronin buffed.
meta_context.meta_summary: Hog 2.6 cycle is the most-played deck (11.5% at 9K+, ~50% WR). Best-performing families: Battle Ram / PEKKA bridge spam (53.8% ranked), Graveyard control (53.6%), Royal Hogs cycle, LavaLoon (Lava Hound is the best win condition at 53.1%), Evo Mortar bait, Golem/Evo Giant beatdown rising with the Giant boost. Top cards by WR: Cannon Cart 53.9%, Rascals 53.6%, Lava Hound 53.1%. Hog Rider is 17.3% usage but 48.4% WR; Mega Knight 47.2% in ranked; Evo Mirror is the worst evolution (43.5%). Knight + Skeletons rated the strongest evolution pair.
meta_context.new_cards_2026: Ronin (July 2026, 5-elixir Legendary, Parry), Minion Giant (Sept 2026, 4-elixir Rare flying win condition), Vines (Sept 2025, 3-elixir Epic immobilizing spell). Heroes (Hero forms of existing cards with single-use abilities) added through 2026: Knight, Giant, Wizard, Mini PEKKA, Magic Archer, Musketeer, Mega Minion, Goblins, Ice Golem, Barbarian Barrel, Balloon, Dark Prince, Bowler, Tombstone, Berserker, Ice Wizard, Electro Wizard, Valkyrie, among others.
